prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certification in Personal Injury Trial Law
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your crash, injuries, insurance issues, and whether your case will likely settle or go to trial. I can help you find a lawyer who’s well suited to your situation; to get started, it helps to know your ZIP code and a few facts about the wreck. Meanwhile, here’s how to pick a strong Houston car‑wreck attorney and what to do next.

How to identify a good Houston car‑wreck lawyer
- Look for experience with car accidents similar to yours (serious injury, wrongful death, commercial vehicle, uninsured motorist, rideshare).  
- Trial experience and a record of taking cases to verdict when necessary.  
- Board certification in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization is a strong positive.  
- Verifiable results: settlements and jury verdicts in comparable cases.  
- Good client communication and responsiveness.  
- Transparent fee structure (usually contingency: commonly 33%–40% if there’s litigation; different if appeal/mediation).  
- Positive independent ratings (State Bar of Texas records, Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Avvo), but read reviews critically.  
- No disciplinary history (check Texas State Bar website).

Where to search and verify credentials
- Texas State Bar (to confirm license & disciplinary history).  
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization (for personal injury trial law certification).  
- Independent rating sites: Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Avvo.  
- Local referrals: friends, family, other attorneys (if you have one for another matter).

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled many cases like mine? What were the results?  
- Do you try cases or mostly settle? What percentage go to trial?  
- Who will handle my case day‑to‑day (partner, associate)?  
- What is your fee and what costs will I be responsible for if we lose?  
- How long do you expect my case to take?  
- Do you have references from past clients?

Immediate steps to protect your claim
- Seek medical attention and follow treatment recommendations.  
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles/injuries, police report, contact info for witnesses.  
- Do not give recorded statements to the other side’s insurer without your lawyer present.  
- Keep records of medical bills, time missed from work, and other expenses.  
- Be aware Texas’ statute of limitations for most personal injury claims is two years from the date of injury.

If you want, I can:
- Find and shortlist well‑rated Houston car‑accident lawyers near you (give me your ZIP or neighborhood).  
- Review names you already have and help you compare them.  
- Provide a printable checklist of documents to bring to consults.

Which would you like to do next?
